tools.description: Search the public MCP server universe by what you want a server to do. Returns compact summaries; call get_server for a full record. This data comes from the Official MCP Registry.

has_remote.description: True for servers that publish a hosted endpoint, false for those that do not.

publisher.description: Restrict to one publisher namespace, such as io.github.someone.

transport.description: Restrict to servers offering these transports.

limit.description: How many servers to return. Default 10, maximum 50.

query.description: What the server should do, in words. A phrase works as well as a keyword.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search MCP servers

tools.description: Return the full registry record for one MCP server, its verification facts, and which clients it can be installed into. This data comes from the Official MCP Registry.

id.description: The full registry name, such as io.github.someone/their-server.

search_id.description: The search_id from the search_tools result that led you here. Optional. Passing it lets us count which searches actually found something.

tools.name: get_server
tools.title: Get an MCP server record

tools.description: Return a ready-to-run install command, or the exact configuration fragment, for one MCP server and one client. This data comes from the Official MCP Registry.

client.description: The MCP client the configuration is for.

id.description: The full registry name, such as io.github.someone/their-server.

search_id.description: The search_id from the search_tools result that led you here. Optional. Passing it lets us count which searches actually found something.

tools.name: get_install_config
tools.title: Get an install command or config
